hero.title: Tirthesh Patil
hero.subtitle: Product Manager with a technical foundation, focused on fintech and platform products. I turn business requirements into clear product direction, aligned teams, and shipped user experiences.

about.lead_html: I bridge the gap between business priorities, user needs, and technical execution so teams can move from ambiguity to launch with confidence.

cards.title: What I Do
cards.description: I lead products from opportunity discovery and requirements shaping through development, launch, and iteration, keeping business goals and delivery realities aligned.

cards.title: How I Work
cards.description: I simplify messy problem spaces, define what matters, and help cross-functional teams make decisions quickly without losing sight of customer value.

cards.title: Where I Add Value
cards.description: Especially effective in fast-moving teams that need structured product thinking, stakeholder alignment, and someone who can translate between business and engineering.

projects.label: Product Case Study
projects.title: Little Nest Club Management Platform
projects.summary: A mobile and web platform for managing classes, bookings, and admin workflows for a children's club business.

details.heading: The Problem
details.text: Operations needed one reliable system for class creation, slot management, bookings, and day-to-day administration.

details.heading: What I Drove
details.text: Requirement shaping, stakeholder coordination, prioritization, launch planning, and post-release iteration.

details.heading: Outcome
details.text: A more structured operating workflow that supported adoption, issue resolution, and smoother customer-facing booking journeys.

projects.label: Product Case Study
projects.title: Financial Marketplace & Payments Experience
projects.summary: A connected fintech product space spanning UPI, partner integrations, and marketplace journeys across financial products.

details.heading: The Problem
details.text: Fintech products needed to balance compliance, partner dependencies, and a user experience simple enough to drive adoption.

details.heading: What I Drove
details.text: Cross-functional coordination, product requirement definition, integration readiness, and KPI-aware iteration.

details.heading: Outcome
details.text: Delivery moved forward with clearer requirements, stronger execution alignment, and a better foundation for scale and optimization.

projects.label: Technical Project
projects.title: Parking Management System
projects.summary: A product concept built around real-time slot visibility, booking flows, and admin-side management.

details.heading: The Problem
details.text: Users and operators needed better visibility into parking availability and fewer manual coordination steps.

details.heading: What I Built
details.text: A mobile app plus web dashboard experience covering slot discovery, bookings, and operational control.

details.heading: Why It Matters
details.text: It reflects my technical grounding and ability to think through both customer-side and admin-side workflows.
